example.title: Load employee names and their departments
description: The tabs contain all application files for this separate Maven project.
The example requires Java 17 or later, Maven and PostgreSQL with an existing `employee_notes` database.
`database/schema.sql` creates the tables in an empty database before `mvn spring-boot:run`.
Hibernate validates the supplied schema. It does not create the tables.
The directory operation loads all employees. A large directory needs a bounded query.
explanation: `left join fetch` loads the optional department while keeping employees with no department.
The service copies each name inside the read transaction.
Returning it does not expose a lazy entity relationship.

richText: Fetching a collection can repeat the parent row in SQL results.
A collection fetch join with pagination can produce incorrect limits or force Hibernate to apply limits in memory.
A bounded ID query followed by a relationship query is one option for that distinct case.
A fetch join to one related department does not multiply rows the way a collection fetch does.
